parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of an instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The mode of the instance. Valid values:

*   `instance`: reserved storage mode
*   `ALIYUN::GPDB::INSTANCE`: elastic storage mode

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --resource-id gp-bp000000000000000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'gp-bp000000000000000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType instance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
